Name: Aimon's Small Swamp Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][center][i][color=#fff2cc]A small swamp themed map with some special tweaks and features.[/color][/i]

[i]﻿Ever wished for a swamp themed farm in Stardew? Now you have it!
This mod adds a relatively small sized custom farm, with lots of water and swampy decor.

 [u] Want Something bigger? Try  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41253]Big Swamp Farm[/url]﻿![/u][/i][/center][i]

[/i][b][center]Big  thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/mods]LooneyLuny[/url] who commissioned me for this map and encouraged me to upload this farm mod here on nexus! If you like witchy and cozy mods, you should definitely[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/mods] check out their mod page!
[/url][/center][/b][/size][size=3]
[b][i][u][color=#ffe599]Note: [/color][/u][/i]there's 2 versions of this mod - one adds new swamp farm as custom one. Another one works as replacement for vanilla Wilderness farm.
If you start your save file anew - I suggest using 1st version of the mod for avoiding issues with other farm mods.[/b]

[color=#fff2cc]Reommended mods:[/color]
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27656]Luny's Purple Swamp Fields[/url] - adds matching witchy grass for the farm.
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]BogWyytch's mods[/url] - if you're looking for witchy buildings and retextures.[/size]

[size=3][u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]2 different recolors - green and purple (and 2 optional recolors for Fall and Winter (Bog's Gray and Kat's Mild))[/size]
[*][size=2]Custom starter giftbox items - (choose before starting new save file!)[/size]
[*][size=2]Special visual effects (mist during rain/night and shadows around map borders)[/size]
[*][size=2]Swamp themed forage spawns on farm (forest forage and mushrooms)[/size]
[*][size=2]Secret Woods passage - adds warps to SecretWoods map.[/size]
[*][size=2]Grandpha's Shed passage - adds warp to Grandpha's Shed map if SVE is installed.[/size]
[*][size=2]Catch different types of fish depends on water type (mountain fish in upper lakes, forest fish in bottom rivers)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][center][b][u][color=#fff2cc]This mod is for Stardew 1.6 only[/color][/u][/b][/center][/size]
[size=3][u][b]Don't want respawnable forage in farm?[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Go to your "Mods" folder, open "Aimon's Small  Swamp Farm", > "[FTM] Small Swamp Farm" and open content.json file with any text editor.[/size]
[*][size=3]Find "ForageSpawnEnabled" and change it to "false"[/size]
[*][size=3]Save the changes.[/size]
[*][size=3]Done![/size]
[/list][size=3][b][u]Don't want mist effects, small pond near farmhoue or water holes for paddy crops?[/u][/b] [/size]
[size=3]You can config all of it in my mod's config! (Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url][size=3]for more convenient ingame config)[/size]

[size=3]Since it's really tidy map, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6854]Build on Any Tile mod [/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url] mods.
[/size]
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Recolor - Green, Purple[/size]
[*][size=2]Bog's Fall Recolor - true/false[/size]
[*][size=2]Kat's Mild Winter Recolor - true/false[/size]
[*][size=2]Mist Effect - Night and Rain, Only Rain, None[/size]
[*][size=2]More Land - Replaces some parts of rivers with dirt in the middle of the map.[/size]
[*][size=2]Water Holes for Paddy Crops - true, false[/size]
[*][size=2]Small Pond - true, false[/size]
[*][size=2]SVE Grandpha's Shed Pathway - true, false[/size]
[*][size=2]Starter Gift - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file.)[/size]
[*][size=2]Starter Giftbox items available: [/size]
[size=3] ﻿ [/size][quote] ﻿﻿- [size=1]Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿ ﻿﻿﻿- [size=1]Swamping- will give you 30 Rice Sprout Seeds, 1 Recycling Machine and 1 Witch Hat[/size]
﻿- Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿  ﻿-Mining - will give you 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item
﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿ ﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/size][/quote][size=3]
[img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img]
[/size][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...
[b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with any recolors and retextures. 
Not compatible with any other mod that edits the Foraging Farm (if you use Vanilla Farm replacement version)
[color=#fff2cc][b]Note:[/b] [/color]if you use Better Water 2 mod, different water configs may affect how water looks in farm (I used Teal, Semi-Opaque option on my screenshots).

[b][color=#ffe599][u]NOTE for SVE compatibility[/u] [/color]- the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [color=#ffe599]x = 89, y = 11 [/color]- change it in SVE config.[/b]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/size]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=2](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip "Aimon's Small Swamp Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=2]Enjoy.[/size]
[/list][/size][/list]
